statement: Jim Jordan wins the House Republican Conference vote for party leader in the 120th Congress between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if the House Republican Conference elects Jim Jordan as its top leader for the 120th Congress in a vote held between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-20, per AP or Reuters.
failure_condition: Steve Scalise or any other member wins the leader vote, or no leader is elected inside the window.

statement: The ANC finishes below 35.0 percent of the national vote in the South African local government elections held on 2026-11-04, per IEC results declared between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-11.
resolution: TRUE if IEC final results declared between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-11 show the ANC below 35.0 percent of the national valid vote; FALSE at 35.0 or above.
failure_condition: The declared national ANC share is 35.0 percent or higher, or no national declaration is made inside the window.

statement: The Knesset approves a new Israeli government in a confidence vote between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if the Knesset plenum passes a confidence vote installing a new government between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-29, per the Knesset website or Reuters; a continuing caretaker government does not count.
failure_condition: No new government has won a Knesset confidence vote inside the window.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range to at least 4.00-4.25 percent on 2026-12-09. Reference: 3.75-4.00 percent target range on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement of 2026-12-09 sets a target range with an upper limit of 4.25 percent or higher, confirmed by FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-12-10.
failure_condition: The target range upper limit stays at 4.00 percent or lower after the 2026-12-09 decision.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above 110.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 98.91 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-31 is 110.00 or higher; FALSE if every settlement in that window is below 110.00.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement inside the window is below 110.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: Congress enacts a law raising or suspending the federal debt limit between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-02, before the new Democratic majorities take their seats.
resolution: TRUE if Congress.gov shows a public law enacted between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-02 that raises or suspends the statutory debt limit at 31 USC 3101.
failure_condition: No statute raising or suspending the debt limit is enacted inside the window.

statement: CISA adds at least one SonicWall vulnerability to the KEV catalog between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog carries a date-added value between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-29 for at least one entry with vendor SonicWall.
failure_condition: No SonicWall entry in the KEV catalog has a date-added value inside the window.

statement: The UK Supreme Court hands down judgment in the Ammori appeal against the proscription of Palestine Action between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if the UK Supreme Court case page for UKSC/2026/0099 records a judgment handed down between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-29, whichever side prevails.
failure_condition: The Supreme Court has not delivered its judgment inside the window.

statement: US forces strike Iranian land or island territory at least once between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-30, with the strike acknowledged on the record by the US government.
resolution: TRUE if CENTCOM, the Pentagon or the president confirms on the record a US strike on Iranian land or island territory occurring between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-30, per Reuters or AP; strikes on vessels do not count.
failure_condition: The United States carried out no acknowledged strike on Iranian land or island territory inside the window.

statement: Russia and Ukraine both confirm a new truce, nationwide or covering energy infrastructure, the Black Sea or a named city, taking effect between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-20.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters or AP reports the Kremlin and Kyiv both confirmed such a truce taking effect between 2026-11-05 and 2026-12-20; prisoner swaps and IAEA repair pauses do not count.
failure_condition: No new truce agreed by both governments takes effect inside the window.
